questions.question: When braking, you should use:

options.text: Only the front brake.
Only the rear brake.
Both brakes.
Either brake, but never both at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes at the same time to stop. They work best together.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?

options.text: Warning
Service
Regulatory
Speed limit

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: The shortest and safest stops are accomplished:

options.text: By using only the rear brake.
By using only the front brake.
By allowing the front tire to lock up.
By using both the front and rear brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: By using both the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes smoothly and gradually for the shortest and safest stops. Do not let either tire skid.

questions.question: In general, the body gets rid of almost ______ per hour.

options.text: One drink
Two drinks
Three drinks
Four drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: One drink
questions.explanation: Your body eliminates about one drink of alcohol per hour.

questions.question: During the day, you should:

options.text: Not ride with your headlight on.
Ride with your headlight on, but only if it is cloudy.
Always ride with your headlight on.
Use your headlight if you think it helps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always ride with your headlight on.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times, even during the day. Other drivers notice you twice as much when your light is on.

questions.question: Which of the following surfaces provides the best traction for a motorcycle?

options.text: A gravel road
Dry pavement
Mud
Lane markings

questions.correctAnswerText: Dry pavement
questions.explanation: Dry pavement gives the best grip. Gravel, mud, wet pavement, ice, snow, lane markings, and metal plates are all slippery and dangerous.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a piece of protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?

options.text: Jacket
Boots
Gloves
Sandals

questions.correctAnswerText: Sandals
questions.explanation: Wear a helmet, eye protection, jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves. Sandals do not protect your feet.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, motorcycle riders should be especially cautious of:

options.text: Motorists looking for a place to park.
Cars leaving their parking spaces.
Oncoming traffic.
Noise.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars leaving their parking spaces.
questions.explanation: Be careful of cars pulling out from parking spaces when you pass parked vehicles.

questions.question: Studies show that when motorcycles have their headlights turned on during the day:

options.text: They are not as easy to see as other vehicles.
They are more visible to other drivers than when their headlights are turned off.
Other drivers are often confused.
They are less safe than when their headlights are turned off.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are more visible to other drivers than when their headlights are turned off.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle with its headlight on is twice as likely to be noticed by other drivers during the day.

questions.question: A simple way to make your motorcycle easier to see is to:

options.text: Ride with a large flag attached to its frame.
Ride with the headlight turned on.
Wave at other drivers.
Ride on the shoulder whenever possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride with the headlight turned on.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times. Wear bright, reflective clothing. Use your turn signals and brake light correctly.

questions.question: Where should you find the best information about your motorcycle?

options.text: The owner's manual
A general book about motorcycles
Someone who owns a different type of motorcycle
A television show about motorcycle riding

questions.correctAnswerText: The owner's manual
questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle. It teaches you about your specific motorcycle.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection to motorcycle riders?

options.text: Leather
Denim
Polyester
Wool

questions.correctAnswerText: Leather
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection when riding a motorcycle.

questions.question: A motorcycle's brake light is:

options.text: More noticeable than a car's brake lights
Less noticeable than a car's brake lights
Less important than a car's brake lights
Easier to see than a car's brake lights

questions.correctAnswerText: Less noticeable than a car's brake lights
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's brake light is usually not as noticeable as a car's brake lights. Flash your brake light before you slow down or stop. This helps other drivers see that you are braking.

questions.question: You should increase the distance between your motorcycle and the vehicle in front of you:

options.text: When stopping will be harder than usual
When you want to look at the scenery
To encourage other drivers to cut you off
To prevent the driver in front from knowing you are there

questions.correctAnswerText: When stopping will be harder than usual
questions.explanation: Increase your following distance when your motorcycle needs more time to stop. Do this on slippery pavement, when you cannot see around the vehicle ahead, or when traffic is heavy and another driver may cut in front of you.

questions.question: What is the main psychoactive ingredient in marijuana?

options.text: THC
TMJ
MRT
AAP

questions.correctAnswerText: THC
questions.explanation: THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is the main psychoactive substance found in marijuana.

questions.question: An approved helmet:

options.text: Lets you see clearly to the sides while riding safely
Limits how far you can see to the sides
Is usually uncomfortable
Has no labels or markings

questions.correctAnswerText: Lets you see clearly to the sides while riding safely
questions.explanation: An approved helmet allows you to see as far to the sides as needed for safe riding. Approved helmets have labels with the manufacturer's name, instructions, and information about safety standards.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Drag your feet on the ground
Point your toes downward
Keep your feet firmly on the footrests
Keep your feet away from the controls

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your feet firmly on the footrests
questions.explanation: Place your feet firmly on the footrests to stay balanced. Do not drag your feet or point your toes down, as this can catch on the road. Keep your feet near the controls so you can reach them quickly if needed.

questions.question: Mirror checks:

options.text: Should be part of your regular scanning routine
Should be avoided because they distract you
Should be avoided because other drivers can see you easily
Are only needed in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be part of your regular scanning routine
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal scanning routine. This helps you know what is behind you and keeps you safe.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Assume they have ridden on a motorcycle before
Not assume they have ridden on a motorcycle before and explain what to do
Not let them ask questions
Not explain anything since they are just a passenger

questions.correctAnswerText: Not assume they have ridden on a motorcycle before and explain what to do
questions.explanation: Your passenger needs to understand how to ride safely for both their safety and yours. Never assume they already know what to do. Give complete instructions before every ride.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Not do a head check if you use your mirrors
Trust that mirrors show everything around your motorcycle
Turn your head and look over your shoulder
Assume drivers will react properly to your turn signal

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any other vehicle. Always turn your head and look over your shoulder to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a good choice for riding clothes?

options.text: A jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs
Boots or shoes that cover your ankles
Gloves made of leather
A baseball cap to cover your hair

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap to cover your hair
questions.explanation: To protect yourself from injury, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a jacket and long pants made of sturdy material, boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: A pre-ride inspection usually takes:

options.text: A few minutes and should be done once a month
A few minutes and should be done before every ride
Over an hour and should be done by a mechanic
Over an hour and only if you will carry a passenger

questions.correctAnswerText: A few minutes and should be done before every ride
questions.explanation: Do a pre-ride inspection before every ride. It takes only a few minutes.

questions.question: In a no passing zone:

options.text: A motorcycle may still pass another vehicle
A motorcycle is not allowed to pass another vehicle
A motorcycle may pass if it can finish before another vehicle approaches
A motorcycle may pass on the shoulder

questions.correctAnswerText: A motorcycle is not allowed to pass another vehicle
questions.explanation: Do not pass in no passing zones. You cannot pass by riding off the main road either.

questions.question: If your shoes have laces, the laces should be:

options.text: Tucked in
Hanging loose
Removed from the shoes
Glued together

questions.correctAnswerText: Tucked in
questions.explanation: Tuck your shoelaces in securely so they do not catch on your motorcycle while riding.

questions.question: A rectangular sign may be a:

options.text: School crossing sign
Railroad crossing sign
Stop sign
Speed limit sign

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs like speed limits are usually rectangular with white background and black lettering. Follow the rules shown on these signs.
